title: nan
authors: Leishman R.C.; McLain T.W.; Beard R.W.
key_contribution: Presents a relative navigation architecture combining visual graph-SLAM with a multiplicative extended Kalman filter for vision-based aerial GPS-denied navigation, verified with hardware flight tests.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
